brief.text:
#1639 — "a smart notepad for Full-timers to note items to ask Trainees in person. All the names with no updates need asking in person."

To ask is a private notepad per Full-timer, grouped by Trainee. The app drafts lines from three signals that already exist:
· Not reached yet
· a Follow-up ask open 3 days
· a Thread question unanswered 3 days

The Full-timer writes their own lines beside them, under a Trainee or under General. No Trainee or other Full-timer ever sees it.

settled.text:
SETTLED in grilling (2026-10-16)

· Lines resolve by Log on behalf (the honest record) or a private Asked tick. No "I followed up" on a Trainee's behalf.
· Asked leaves the signal open; the line returns only on a NEW signal, never on a timer.
· Ticked lines stay struck through 7 days; Clear done empties them sooner.
· Contacts with no Trainee tied get their own group, last.
· Team filter as on Around the team; groups sorted most-open first; hand-written lines before drafted, drafted oldest first.
· No notifications. My Day pointer card carries the count.

mobile.text:
Phone is where it's used — you're standing next to Jae. The page opens on the whole list, but tapping a Trainee header narrows to them alone, so the conversation is one screen.

Every target 44px. Bottom nav unchanged and omitted.
